verdict.rationale: Pulumi Neo explicitly supports natural-language infrastructure commands ('Tell Neo what you need in plain English... Give me a VPC with a subnet in every AZ'), and the MCP server lets AI assistants generate/manage infrastructure code and delegate to Neo, giving genuine NL operation paths. However this is a distinct product layer (Neo) rather than the core Pulumi CLI/engine, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence corroborating real-world reliability of these NL commands. Missing for 10: independent verification of Neo's natural-language accuracy, broader NL coverage beyond the MCP/Neo layer, and confirmation this isn't limited/preview functionality.
